description:
On the go grub is no mess with this kit!  An updated version of a classic military mess kit, Rothco's includes a fork, spoon, and 2 microwave-safe trays (1 with a divider) and snaps shut with lock cover. The cover is built with dual snap locking closures and space to hold your utensils while keeping contents contained.  Compact and lightweight enough to store in your backpack without inconvenience.  Dimensions when closed: 8" x 5.75"
 x 3.25"
